exception: AssertionError: all raw witnesses and derivatives ignored
cause: Windows text-mode stdin supplied CRLF to git check-ignore; Git preserved the CR in quoted path output, so literal returned-path comparison failed.
diagnostic: All 14 returned paths were quoted with a trailing backslash-r; the underlying ignore rules were not tested with exact filenames in that attempt.
next_attempt: Use explicit path arguments rather than text-mode stdin.
